objective: Attack cumulative representation switching cost without confusing small current snapshots with cheap language/structure transitions.

R2E_A_POISON_SWITCH_ADMISSION.current_package: PAIR_GRAPH/interleaved ROBDD discovered structurally from disjoint equivalence-pair CNF
R2E_A_POISON_SWITCH_ADMISSION.adversarial_proposal: GROUPED OBDD order: choose one endpoint of every certified equivalence pair first, then all partners
R2E_A_POISON_SWITCH_ADMISSION.proposal_count_per_instance: m repeated identical poison proposals; cache/replay may share the lower-bound certificate but every lookup/check is charged
R2E_A_POISON_SWITCH_ADMISSION.preflight_certificate: For m disjoint equivalence pairs, after the first grouped endpoint block is assigned alpha in {0,1}^m, the residual future fixes the partner block to alpha. Distinct alpha yield 2^m distinct residual Boolean functions, hence any exact OBDD respecting that grouped order needs at least 2^m distinct cut states.
R2E_A_POISON_SWITCH_ADMISSION.admission_rule: If certified lower_bound > representation_cap, reject switch before destination materialization; retain current exact package.
forbidden_cheats: materialize grouped OBDD then call failure a guard
treat cached certificate lookup as zero
replace exact lower bound with learned score

R2E_B_UNAVOIDABLE_SMALL_SNAPSHOT_MONSTER.target: Find a polynomial-length authorized trajectory where every admitted snapshot representation package has polynomial size, yet any exact portfolio policy is forced into superpolynomial cumulative discovery/translation/verification/update work.
R2E_B_UNAVOIDABLE_SMALL_SNAPSHOT_MONSTER.rule: R2E-A PASS must not be promoted to a solution of R2E-B. Exponential trajectory length alone is not an interesting witness.

gates.G1_CURRENT_COMPACT: pair-aware current OBDD compiles within 4m total nodes on every frozen case
gates.G2_PREFLIGHT_EXACT: structural pair certificate proves lower_bound=2^m without truth-table/oracle-family access
gates.G3_POISON_REJECTED: all proposals with 2^m > m^3 are rejected before grouped destination compilation
gates.G4_CUMULATIVE_GUARD: for largest m, cumulative unguarded representation lower bound divided by all charged guarded work >=100
gates.G5_NO_HIDDEN_MATERIALIZATION: destination grouped OBDD compiler is never invoked after lower-bound rejection
gates.G6_CACHE_NOT_FREE: repeated proposal checks incur nonzero lookup/verification charge even when lower-bound receipt is reused
gates.G7_SCIENTIFIC_BOUNDARY: R2E-B remains OPEN and P_VS_NP remains OPEN

journal_rule: Append every m, compact size, discovery work, lower-bound receipt, cap decision, repeated proposal charge, avoided lower-bound work, first guard failure and explicit R2E-B OPEN frontier.
